title: Does the gradient band?
fullTitle: FFmpeg 10-bit to 8-bit Banding: format=yuv420p Already Dithers, Only sws_dither=none Changes It

scenes.narration: You convert ten bit video to eight bit, and a gradient may turn into steps. Does the converter dither, and do the dither options help? A ramp of two hundred fifty six ten bit levels, four pixels each, f f m peg six point one point one.
captions: Does a 10 bit gradient band at 8 bit?

scenes.narration: Reader one is Node, reading the raw eight bit plane. Reader two is f f m peg: a checksum of each output and the mean of every two by two block. Control: ten bit to ten bit changes nothing. Known positive: rgb eight, later.
captions: Node plane reader, ffmpeg md5 and block means.
Control: 10 bit to 10 bit, 0 pixels differ.

scenes.narration: Plain format equals yuv four two zero p is not truncation. Sixty five values, not sixty four, with runs of five point three pixels. A two by two dither cell steps one pixel in four up, then two, then three, so every block averages the ten bit value exactly.
captions: Every 2 x 2 block mean equals the ideal.

scenes.narration: Switch it off with s w s underscore dither equals none, and the bands go flat. On six point one point one it truncates: sixty four bands of sixteen pixels, mean error minus zero point three seven five. On eight point one point two it rounds: sixty five values, mean error plus zero point one two five. A two by two block is off by half a level or more.

The other options: bayer, ed, a dither, x dither, auto, and flags equals plus error diffusion. Seven spellings, one checksum. Only none changes the output. For yuv four two zero p, error diffusion changes nothing.
Are the readers blind to dither? The same eight spellings with rgb eight output give five different outputs. The options work, just not for yuv four two zero p.

No option adds levels: a ramp of one thousand twenty four levels ends with two hundred fifty six in every spelling. Banding after conversion comes from the source or the encoder, not from a missing flag. Not tested: other builds, real footage, scaled output, x two six four.
captions: No flag adds levels: 1024 in, 256 out.
Not tested: other builds, real footage.
